name: MAS Guidelines on Artificial Intelligence Risk Management
nature: Guidelines. Effective 7 October 2027; Section 5 (life-cycle controls) and Section 6 expectations by 7 October 2028.

controls.expectation: The institution keeps primary accountability for third-party AI and tests it in its own context.
controls.note: Covers testing in the institution's context; transparency, supply-chain and contract assessments are outside ModelAssure.

controls.expectation: Test against measurable thresholds under plausible conditions, including edge cases.
Pre-deployment reviews are performed by parties not involved in development; high-materiality uses need formal independent validation.
Classify the significance of changes, re-approve significant ones, and keep version tracking and rollback.
controls.note: Rollback and decommissioning are operated by the institution.

controls.expectation: Document in enough detail for an independent party to understand and replicate results.
Define roles, escalation and authority; keep records of interventions.
Define fairness, assess protected attributes and proxies, and document mitigations.
Scale explainability to materiality; credit decisions need more.
controls.note: Reason codes are captured as evidence but not assessed for adequacy.

controls.expectation: Track metrics and drift; manage incidents.
controls.note: Production monitoring is a later capability.
